title: Prime Minister congratulates Women’s Cricket Team on winning Gold medal at Asian Games
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated the Women’s Cricket Team on winning the Gold medal at the Asian Games, calling it a splendid triumph for Indian cricket.
The Prime Minister stated that it was a commanding performance at the Games, marked by confidence, skill, and wonderful teamwork. He noted that this victory also brings India its first Gold of this edition of the Games. He added that the team has made the nation proud and will inspire countless young cricketers across the country, while extending his best wishes to the entire squad.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared:
"A splendid triumph for Indian cricket!
Heartiest congratulations to our Women’s Cricket Team on winning the Gold medal at the Asian Games. It was a commanding performance at the Games, marked by confidence, skill and wonderful teamwork.
This victory also brings India its first Gold of this edition of the Games. The team has made the nation proud and will inspire countless young cricketers across the country.
Best wishes to the entire squad: PM @narendramodi"
